proposed_widenings.name: ProficiencyGrantSubject.save
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive half grants proficiency in all saving throws, but the current grant_proficiency surface can only represent skill, weapon-category, and armor-category proficiencies.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your physical and mental discipline grant you proficiency in all saving throws.

proposed_widenings.name: class_feature_composite_with_triggered_reaction
proposed_widenings.justification: This feature combines a passive grant with a reactive spend-on-failure rider. Class features currently allow composite passive+activation only, not passive+triggered_reaction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll it, and you must use the new roll.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.shared_pool_reference
proposed_widenings.justification: The reroll spends from the monk's existing Focus Point pool, not from an owned use-count or charge pool defined on this feature.

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.failed_saving_throw
proposed_widenings.justification: The reactive half triggers on the owner failing a saving throw, which is not representable in the current reaction trigger grammar.
proposed_widenings.evidence: whenever you make a saving throw and fail

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_roll_reroll
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic rerolls a failed save and forces use of the new result. The v4 taxonomy includes reroll pressure, but the authored surface and tracer do not expose a reroll effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: reroll it, and you must use the new roll

notes: No honest existing encoding fits. Authoring only the passive half would omit a core deterministic rider, and faking the reroll as a different effect would produce a misleading trace.
